content:
Many Black Friday deals start tomorrow, but plenty of incredible discounts are available today. PlayStation 5 games have dropped to their lowest prices ever, or you can save $5 on The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. If you’re looking to grab some gift cards, Best Buy is giving away $10 Best Buy Gift Cards with select $100 gift card purchases. Take a look at those deals and plenty more below:

TL;DR - The Best Deals for November 18

Pokémon TCG 30th Celebration Drawing

Target has a few drawings up for Pokémon TCG 30th Celebration. All prices are well below the market value, if you’re lucky enough to score an invite. Honestly, this is the best way to beat the bots and scalpers right now. You get one entry per account, and you’ll be notified by email if selected. You must complete the purchase before the deadline shown in the email. You really have nothing to lose by entering.

$5 Off The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

It’s hard to believe it has already been two weeks since The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time dropped. If you’ve yet to get a copy and are looking to save a little, Amazon has $5 off a digital copy. You can even opt to buy it as a gift to send to someone. In IGN’s Ocarina of Time review, the game earned an “Amazing” 9/10 rating. Logan Plant found, "Nintendo skillfully melds the world and dungeon design of classic Zeldas with the movement and presentation of its more recent games, creating both a beautiful retelling of a legend and a rich adventure that stands on its own."

Stellar Blade Under $30 and More PS5 Physical Game Deals

PlayStation’s Black Friday Sale brings discounts on physical PS5 games. It’s the first major price drop for the discs of Marvel’s Wolverine and Control Resonant. But Stellar Blade is another incredible deal. You can pick up a copy for the lowest price I’ve seen: $29.97. Stellar Blade “is a gorgeous action game with excellent character and monster design and exciting combat that continues to evolve in fun and interesting ways across the 30-hour adventure,” according to Mitchell Saltzman. Read even more in IGN’s Stellar Blade review. There’s even a sequel in the works, Stellar Blade: Blood Rain.

See even more PS5 game deals below:

Get a Free $10 Best Buy Gift Card with a $100 Gift Card

Who doesn’t love to get a gift card? Best Buy’s Deal of the Day is great for those shopping for the hard-to-buy-for. A whole bunch of $100 gift cards come with a free $10 Best Buy Gift Card. You can’t go wrong with Amazon, but DoorDash, Instacart, Home Depot, Uber, Sephora, and more also come with a free $10 Best Buy Gift Card. See all the $100 gift cards here.

$10 Off GTA VI Ultimate Edition

GTA VI is out tomorrow. If you’re looking to save on the 10/10 rated game, you can get $10 off the Ultimate Edition for PS5 or Xbox. Just take advantage of Newegg’s $10 discount on $100 PlayStation Store and $100 Xbox Store eGift Cards. Enter code “BNWF3453” for the PlayStation Store discount and code “BNWF3451” for the Xbox Store. Beyond buying the Ultimate Edition of GTA VI, you can redeem these gift cards for other games, DLC, subscriptions, and more.

Bowers & Wilkins Px7 S2e Headphones Hit New Low Price

Bowers & Wilkins’ Px7 S2e are luxury over-ear headphones, and you can get them for the lowest price I’ve seen. With 24-bit processing and aptX Adaptive hi-res audio support, you’ll listen to music just as the artist intended. The 30-hour battery life and solid active noise cancellation with transparency modes are great for travel. Of course, you can tune the audio to your liking, too.

Alienware Aurora RTX 5080 Gaming PC for $2,800

A new Alienware Aurora RTX 5080 gaming PC is $2,799.99 at Amazon. It’s sure to sell out, so act fast. The GeForce RTX 5080 16GB GPU is one of the fastest cards available and can handle even the most demanding games in 4K at high settings. That’s paired with an Intel Core Ultra 9 285 24-core processor delivering a max turbo frequency of 5.6GHz, 32GB of DDR5-5600MHz RAM, and a 1TB SSD.

$9 Travel Power Strip Extension Cord

Traveling during the holiday? This compact Amazon Basics Power Strip Cube 3 may be just what you need. It’s only $8.99 on Woot, and Prime members get free shipping. Featuring a five-foot cord, it’s great for getting power from hard-to-reach outlets. It also adds three AC outlets supporting up to 1250W, a USB-C(15W), and two USB-A(12W) ports for plenty of connectivity options.

Baseus 20,000mAh 45W USB Power Bank for $21

Don’t run out of charge during holiday travel with the Baseus 20,000mAh 45W USB Power Bank. With the code "WU64LWOG" at checkout on Amazon, you can score it for $20.99, and you don’t need to be a Prime member. The 20,000mAh (74Whr) capacity means it’s ready to charge the Nintendo Switch 2 or an iPhone Pro over three times. Two built-in 45W USB-C cables clip together to form a loop, making things even more convenient. There’s also a 45W USB-C port and a 33W USB-A port available.

LEGO Lightning McQueen Hits New Low on Amazon

The LEGO Speed Champions Lightning McQueen car from the classic Pixar movie Cars is down to its lowest price yet on Amazon. This build is great for kids, Disney fans, and even car enthusiasts, and it packs surprisingly detailed features for the $22.39 price tag. There's the iconic lightning bolt, a Rust-Eze logo, and even a Lightyear logo. It’s also one of the only Speed Champions cars with undercarriage details.

See more Black Friday LEGO deals below:

Save $50 on the MacBook Neo

Apple’s most budget-friendly MacBook, the Neo, just dropped to its lowest price since the June price hike. You can save $50 on the compact laptop, which offers a 13-inch Liquid Retina display, 8GB of RAM, 256GB of storage, and up to 16 hours of battery life. It runs on an A18 Pro chip, the same found in the iPhone 16 Pro, and it’s surprisingly powerful and snappy for your day-to-day workload. The Neo even significantly outperformed the original M1 MacBook Air in testing. Wes Davis gave the laptop an “Amazing” 9/10 rating in IGN’s review and said, “The MacBook Neo is sleek, well-designed, and incredibly capable for its price point.”

Check out more Apple Black Friday deals on Amazon below, including the AirPods Pro 3:

Black Friday 4K Blu-ray Deals

There are some incredible Black Friday deals on 4K Blu-rays. Amazon has a bunch of 4K Blu-rays down to $12.99, with Batman Knightfall: Part 1 and Obsession as major highlights. For Black Friday, Gruv is offering a similar $12.99 movie sale, or if you’re looking to pick up a few UHD discs to add to your collection, it’s worth scanning its ‘3 for $33’ sale. Plus, Criterion Collection has a large selection of films 50% off.

$129 PS5-Compatible 1TB SSD

Storage prices are ridiculous these days. If you’re looking for a cheap SSD to throw in your PS5, Walmart has a Verbatim 1TB SSD for just $129. This PS5-compatible PCIe Gen4 x4 SSD features an M.2 2280 form factor and an aluminum heatsink installed–a must for the PS5’s toasty slot. It far exceeds the console’s minimum sequential read-speed requirements, hitting up to 7,000MB/s. For added peace of mind, the SSD also comes with a 2-year limited warranty.

$18 Off the JBL Go 4 Bluetooth Speaker

Looking for a compact, durable speaker ideal for travel, hiking, and camping? Get the JBL Go 4 at its lowest price yet as an early Black Friday deal. You can even choose from a few different colorways. This speaker is small enough to fit in the palm of your hand but packs a powerful, bassy punch and up to 7 hours of battery life on a single charge. The IP67 water-and-dust proof rating also means it can handle an accidental dip in the pool or a drop in the sand.

Want something a little nicer but still portable? Check out the Harman Kardon Onyx Studio that’s 80% off.

Save on DualSense Controllers

Many DualSense controllers have been discounted for Black Friday. This includes special edition releases like the 007 First Light and Marathon designs. My personal favorite, the Chroma lineup, is down $20. These controllers feature a cool pearlescent finish, similar to the GTA VI DualSense, that shifts color depending on the angle. As for the controller itself, adaptive triggers, a familiar layout, and reliable performance make it an option for PS5, PC, and more.

Check out more DualSense controller deals below:

MTG x Star Trek Booster Boxes Hit New Lows

The MTG x Star Trek Play Booster Box has dropped to $109 on Amazon. This Universes Beyond set just came out last week and is already seeing a significant discount. The 30 Play Booster Packs end up being $3.63 each. With these cards, you can build your own Federation as you put together a deck to play with friends.

You can also score a box of 12 Star Trek Collector Boosters for $399.99. That’s the lowest price I’ve seen for packs full of rares, foils, special treatments, and more.

$30 Off a DualSense Edge Controller

It’s not just the regular DualSense that received a discount; the pro-level PS5 controller, the DualSense Edge, is down to just $169.99 during PlayStation’s Black Friday Sale. That’s $30 in savings off the black and white variants. This controller delivers premium features including adjustable trigger stops, swappable stick caps, replaceable stick modules, and mappable back buttons. It’s a great option for playing GTA VI, which drops in just a few days. Read IGN’s full DualSense Edge review to find out more.

PlayStation Pulse Explore Buds Hit Low Price

Brand-new, Midnight Black PlayStation Pulse Explore Buds have dropped to the lowest price yet. These are one of three wireless headsets with PlayStation Link technology, making them the only earbuds that can connect wirelessly to the PS Portal without any extra hardware. In IGN’s review of the PlayStation Pulse Explore Buds, Jaron Schneider found the earbuds “sound fantastic for gaming and work with no muss or fuss right out of the box.”
